answers.goal: Creative Executive at a studio, specifically on the TV side
answers.drew: I’ve always loved reading and watching movies and television, and I would typically imagine myself working behind-the-scenes of my favorite projects. Movies and TV shows positively impacted my life, and I want to give it forward by helping others feel seen and heard and inspiring the next generation of storytellers.
answers.seeking: Especially looking to connect with others in the development space who are looking to be producers or creative execs, but I can’t wait to meet people from all over the industry!
answers.inspiration: Recently Patrick Ball has been a big inspiration for me. Hustling for 15 years before landing his role on The Pitt reinforced the importance of passion, hard work, and perseverance, especially for the entertainment industry.
